# Hey We Market

> Hey We Market is a full service digital marketing agency in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. It helps businesses grow through strategy-led social media, paid advertising, content creation, SEO and AI search visibility, branding, and website optimization.

## Key facts
- Services: SEO and AEO (AI search visibility), Google Business Profile and local SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics and conversion optimization, content creation and production, social media management, commercial ad shoots, branding and design, website design and development
- Industries served: restaurants, cafés, hotels, resorts, healthcare, fashion, real estate, education, creators, startups, local businesses
- Process: Discover → Strategy → Create → Launch → Scale
- Contact: info@heywemarket.com · +91 98260 26029
- Parent company: Innovativebiz Technologies (https://innovativebiz.in/)
- Address: 3rd Floor, Gurbakshish Arcade, Bawadiya Kalan, Pallavi Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462039
- Founders: Ankita Singh (Co Founder, Strategy & Creative), Divyansh Singh (Co Founder, Brand & Growth)
- Positioning: strategy-first marketing built around each business rather than generic templates
